purpose: Teach: お誘い/腕時計/立ち寄っ/ふく/うわさ/閉じる/スリム/じゅう

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お祭りのお誘い、もらったな、町内会から、出ようか、ばあさん。
lines.en: We got an invitation to the festival from the neighborhood association. Should we go, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried. The voice of someone in their 70s offering a quiet suggestion. A pause before "dear" — checking in, not commanding. Warm nostalgia underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。あなたの腕時計、もう、五十年来、使っているわよね、すごいわ。
lines.en: Yes. And that watch of yours — you've been wearing it for fifty years now. That's wonderful.
lines.style: Admiring but matter-of-fact. The tone of someone noticing and naming something true. Tender without fussing. A gentle emphasis on the "fifty years" — not sentimental, just real.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 帰り、孫の家、立ち寄ったよ、可愛かったな、孫。
lines.en: On the way home, I stopped by our grandchild's house. They were so sweet.
lines.style: Soft, almost to himself. The voice of someone still holding the warmth of that visit. A small smile in the delivery — not seeking agreement, just sharing the feeling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 眼鏡、優しく、ふくようにして、傷がつくのよ、強く、こすると。
lines.en: Your glasses — wipe them gently, you know. If you rub too hard you'll scratch the lenses.
lines.style: Practical advice delivered with affection, not instruction. Matter-of-fact but not unkind. The rhythm of someone who has said helpful things many times before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 近所のうわさ、最近、気になることが、多くてな、ばあさん。
lines.en: The neighborhood gossip lately — there are so many things that bother me, dear.
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful. The opening carries a slight weight. A pause at the comma — gathering his thoughts. The voice of someone genuinely concerned, not sensationalizing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 雨戸、夜は、閉じるようにしましょうね、防犯のために、あなた。
lines.en: Let's make sure we close the shutters at night, won't we? For safety, dear.
lines.style: Gentle but clear instruction. Practical care wrapped in warmth. Not worried, just sensible — the voice of someone who looks after what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃のばあさん、スリムだったよな、写真で見ると。
lines.en: You were so slim when you were young. When I look at the photos.
lines.style: Soft, half-teasing without edge. A memory returning to him. The gentleness of someone noticing beauty across time — not comparing, just remembering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、一日じゅう、横になってばかりよ、私、運動不足ね。
lines.en: Lately I just lie down all day. I'm not getting enough exercise.
lines.style: Self-aware and rueful. A dry laugh underneath. Not seeking sympathy — just naming the truth with a wry, generous acceptance of aging.
